arguments.sql:
SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_header', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'headers_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_null_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_bad_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_date_outside_period', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_both_drcr', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_neg', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_null_amt', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT" IS NULL OR "CR_AMT" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_jrnl_no', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_jrnl', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_no_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_amt_ne_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_pay_inv', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_vend_invno', count(*) FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'closeperiod_wrong', count(*) FROM "GLPERD" WHERE "CLOSE_DT" IS NULL
SELECT * FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" UNION SELECT max("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH") ORDER BY 1
